question: Identify the synonym of 'Jovial':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Jovial"** means cheerful, friendly, or full of joy. (खुशमिजाज)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher’s jovial nature made the class enjoyable and lively.
 
 
• The synonym of **"Jovial"** is **"Happy"** (खुश).
 
 
• **Example:** She felt extremely happy after receiving the good new
